class.name: AudioEffectSteamSpatial
class.brief_description: Spatializes a point source to stereo using Steam Audio's built-in HRTF.
class.description: Converts a mono point source into binaural stereo based on its listener-relative [member direction]. The current implementation folds Godot's stereo bus input to mono before spatialization, applies [member gain], and uses Steam Audio's built-in HRTF. This is a render effect only. It does not locate a Godot listener or source, trace geometry, calculate propagation delay, or render reflections and reverb. [AudioStreamQPlayer3D] updates its parameters from Godot transforms. It can also be driven directly by another source of spatial parameters. Place [AudioEffectSteamDirect] before this effect when direct-path filtering is required. Output is always a stereo binaural signal intended for headphones; it is not a loudspeaker-surround decoder.

method.name: set_source_parameters
method.description: Updates [member direction], [member gain], and [member spatial_blend] together. This reduces main-thread property traffic when a source moves.

members.member: Unit vector in listener-local space pointing from the listener toward the source. Nonzero values are normalized automatically; a zero vector becomes [code]Vector3(0, 0, -1)[/code].
Nonnegative linear gain applied to the mono source immediately before HRTF rendering. This is an integration convenience and is not a field of Steam Audio's [code]IPLBinauralEffectParams[/code].
HRTF measurement interpolation used when [member direction] falls between measured locations.

Blend between unspatialized mono and fully HRTF-spatialized output, clamped to [code]0.0[/code]–[code]1.0[/code]. Because this implementation first folds input to mono, [code]0.0[/code] does not preserve the original stereo image.

constants.constant: Uses the nearest measured HRTF direction. This is the lower-cost option.
Interpolates between nearby HRTF measurements. This is smoother for wide-band material but costs more CPU.
